underlying_goal: Use custom skills to analyze NVIDIA's latest earnings report and investment value, then export results as PDF
friction_detail: Skills were packaged as ZIP files and not recognized initially; PDF generation hit CJK font compatibility issues requiring fallback to reportlab.
brief_summary: User wanted NVIDIA earnings and value investing analysis using custom skills and PDF export; Claude fixed skill recognition issues, ran both analyses, and successfully generated a 9-page PDF.
